Keep running, Mochelo!!\nWe'll be fine somehow if we can make it to the\ncity...!
Whoa! What the hey is this?!\nI just thought everything was gonna be okay.\nC'mon, can you please stop bringing us trouble?
P-please don't say that~.\nI'm also running an errand, you know.\nCan you do me a little favor?
I need to carry this honey to Sofya City...
If that's the case, you're almost there, aren't\nyou...?
N-no, that's not the case...Oh no, they're here!
O-oh my, oh my goshhhh!\nNo, no, no, holy moly!!\nAaah, hey, c'mon finish 'em!
*pant* ...Geez, what was that...?
Don't ask me, I dunno either. Carrying this honey\nto Sofya City was supposed to be an easy job, but\nwe were attacked by those things on our way.
I'm glad that you helped us.\nCan you watch this for me for a minute?\nI'll go tell the client and I'll be right back...
Hey, wait!\nJeez, I'll make you pay for asking me to watch\nthis thing for you when you come back!
...Huh? What's she doin'?
What?! No, please!\nI just wanna deliver this, that's it!
No! Because from your story, monsters are\ntargeting that thing and may attack. I can't let\nsuch a dangerous thing enter the city.
Stay where you are, at least until we figure out\nwhat's causing it!
O-oh, no way...\nUgh, I knew something was not quite right when the\nclient agreed to pay that much just for this...
Oh! Do you have food?!\nI was supposed to get paid after doing this job,\nbut as you can see, it's a mess now...
It can't be helped. Since you will enter the city\nlater, we can share some of our food with you...\nBut make sure you pay later!
Phew, somehow I managed to calm the monster in my\ntummy...But it's not enough at all for Mochelo.
Who cares, I won't sacrifice my food just to make\nthat thing full.\nAnyway, what's going on?
Honestly, I'm not sure what's going on either.\nPerhaps, this honey is too valuable...
I heard the merchant coming to the city was\nattacked though, could this be the cause?
Well, I told the sentry that the thing is already\nhere. I bet if the client hears about it, they'll\ndo something about it. I'll pay you later.
Finally found ya!
Oh my gosh, what?!
Don't play dumb with me...That's my special honey!\nHow dare you took it away from me...! You're not\ngetting away with it! I'll have it back!!
Whaaat?!\nIt's not like we stole it though...
I don't wanna hear any excuses!!
Y-you must be kidding me!\nI won't get paid without the honey,\nI can't let you have it!
Please! Help me guys!\nI promise I'll reward you later!
Jeez, I'm confused now...\nI understand that you guys are bees and make\nhoney, but...Are you sure you didn't sell it?
It's true that I agreed to sell my honey to the\nmerchant, but she took my special honey too! I\ndon't remember agreeing to sell my special honey!
If you insist on not returning it, I, Mieli the\nqueen bee, will be your opponent!
Why don't we return it?
Ask her why it's here.
What? No! What are you talking about!\nReturning it would make all the work they've done\ngo to waste! Don't you feel sorry for them?
P-Pelulu...!
Besides, they won't be able to pay for the food\nI've shared with them!
Grrr! Well, if you're not gonna give it back,\nI guess I'll have to use violence!
Anyway, you said that this special honey is yours,\nbut...Why is it here?
I have exactly the same question!\nHumans like you are always busy making sweets\ncalled chocolate at this time of the year...
You never care about honey which is the best\nnatural sweetener...But why would you steal my\nspecial honey?!
No, it's not like we're ignoring honey because\nwe're too busy making chocolate. Besides, we don't\nknow anything about your honey!
Whatever! If you insist on not returning it,\nI'll use violence! I'll make you realize how\nwonderful honey is!
Oh gosh...We shouldn't have asked her,\nit's become more complicated now...
Alright, if you think you can beat us, fine then!\nHey, you too ready up!
U-ugh...I-It's not supposed to end this way...
I came here after talking to the sentry...\nWhat exactly is going on here?\nWhat happened to the thing I requested?
Hey, Lefina, how did you buy that honey?
Eh? I was searching for ingredients to add some\nfancy flavor to my sweets, then a merchant in the\narea offered me some rare and precious honey...
And I've already paid for it, so I think it's a\nlegitimate transaction...
I see...That merchant must have pretended that she\nhad bought the honey, but actually she just took\nit without permission.
Although I've paid for it, I don't think I can\nuse the honey for my sweets if it was obtained\nthat way...
So you will return my special honey right?
Yes, of course.
Phew, I thought it was a dangerous thing that\ncould attract monsters, but it seems that it's\nokay now.
Right, we'll let her have it back,\nso it's not dangerous anymore here.
I see. So where is it now?
Ooh, it's right th...Hey where is it?
Mochelo!!\nD-don't tell me you...
And you say it was good...?!\nWhat? Just a little nibble you say?\nBut you ate the whole thing!!
Um, er, that's umm...
O-okay, I think I got it...\nWell, I'll be leaving then...\nJ-just stop bringing in dangerous things...
W-well, too bad I couldn't get the ingredient...\nBut let's just be glad that it didn't turn into\na big commotion in the city...
Phew...yeah, we should be glad...\nWait, no way! All the honey is gone now you know!!
Umm...\nThe fact that my special honey is gone is\nannoying indeed, however...
I think the merchant who stole it is to blame.\nAnd since she was willing to return it,\nI'll forgive them this time...
Also I'm sorry for dragging you into this.\nI'll give you this as a token of apology.\nPlease accept it.
Oh, what a relief!\nWe'll head off then!
Huh? Excuse me? What is it?\nD-didn't you say that you have forgiven us?
I won't ask you to return what you have eaten.\nBut, you have to pay for it with your body.
I think the big guy over there can help me with\nvarious stuff. You only need to work in our hive\nuntil you get enough to pay for the honey.
Whaaat~?! N-no, no, no, help us~!!
Hey, wait!
P-Pelulu...!
These guys owe me too cuz I let them eat my food.\nFeel free to make them work for you, but do you\nmind if I ask you to pay for them first?
U-unbelievable~!!
Make sure you don't steal anything, not even food,\nokay?
Can you do me a favor?\nIt's true that the merchant was to blame for\nstealing my special honey, but...
I think there's also a problem with me and my\nsubordinates for allowing it to be stolen so\neasily! Can we have a duel with you as a training?
What...?\nWhy would we do that?
Of course I'll give you a reward!\nI can't give you my special honey, but still I'm a\nqueen, so you can expect something good from me...
Fine, I see there's no reason to say no now.\nGo ahead and let them fight you!
